column1: # Extra files for the image's Straylight tree, each checked by SHA-256.
# This is the hook for speech output (Kokoro TTS in straylight-listen): when that
# lands, add its model, voices and runtime library here, bump STRAYLIGHT_COMMIT in
# pins.sh to the commit that uses them, and re-pin SHA256SUMS. No line = nothing extra.
#   sha256   source (relative to the lenovo-8 tree, or absolute)   destination in the image   mode
